summary: Error screen follow-up: the screen cannot blank the page whatever was thrown (the panel fails alone; a static last resort with Reload); the description limit counted as the server counts it; collected lines sent inert as code spans, with no host in the page line; session sentences judged against the current state; a report sent during a dismissal reported as sent; the logo mark in the header. Lows-only on its first pass. Left: a screen that stopped signed out says 'another account' when someone signs in; the closure line is not re-judged; the refusal says 'characters' while counting bytes; the name field still counted in characters.
